name: Claude Fable 5.1
archDisplay: Proprietary frontier model (architecture and size undisclosed); adaptive thinking with selectable effort (low → max), 1M-token context, text+image in / text out
note: Anthropic's September 1, 2026 Mythos-class flagship, shipping as `claude-fable-5-1` on the Claude API, AWS, Google Cloud and Microsoft Foundry. List price is unchanged from Fable 5 at $10/$50 per Mtok — the change is cache reads, cut 75% to $0.25/Mtok, which Anthropic measures as roughly 25% lower cost on typical workloads and up to ~45% on context-heavy agentic ones. Defaults to High effort in Claude Code and Medium in Claude Cowork and on claude.ai. Fable 5.1 and Mythos 5.1 are the SAME underlying model with different safeguard levels; this row is the generally-available one. The gains concentrate in long, tool-using work — Terminal-Bench-Science more than doubles (24.7 → 52.6) and AutomationBench nearly doubles (17.1 → 31.4) — while already-strong short coding moves ~3 points (CursorBench 70.5 → 73.4). PROVENANCE — the launch table is vendor-run with production safeguards ON, which Anthropic says likely depresses several rows (both Fable 5.1 and Fable 5 scored zero on the tasks where safeguards intervened on OSWorld 2.0, as did Fable 5 on AutomationBench). Anthropic publishes rows it loses: Fable 5 beats it on ARC-AGI-1 (98.5 vs 97.5), GPT-5.6 Sol leads ARC-AGI-2 (92.5 vs 90.0), and Opus 5 leads SWE-bench Multimodal and HealthBench Professional. It headlines NO SWE-bench Verified figure — the 95.0% widely re-attributed to it is Fable 5's June number. Independent checks agree on direction: Artificial Analysis ranks it first on Intelligence Index v4.1.1 (66), Vals AI first on the Vals Index (67.87%), and ARC Prize ran ARC-AGI-1/2 on its own semi-private set. OSWorld 2.0 here is the benchmark authors' August 2026 task release, which Anthropic says is not comparable with earlier OSWorld 2.0 publications.

results.notes: SWE-bench Pro, Claude Fable 5.1 / Mythos 5.1 System Card Table 8.1.A; best in row vs Fable 5 (80.0), Opus 5 (79.2), GPT-5.6 Sol (64.6). Corroborated as the leaderboard-leading published row on BenchLM's September 2026 SWE-bench Pro snapshot.
SWE-bench Multilingual, System Card Table 8.1.A; up from Fable 5's 86.6 but BEHIND Opus 5 (89.5).
SWE-bench Multimodal, System Card Table 8.1.A; behind Opus 5 (59.4) — one of the rows Anthropic publishes without softening.

Terminal-Bench 4.0 (66 tasks: computational biology, physics simulation, CAD, formal proofs), System Card Table 8.1.A. Unsafeguarded Mythos 5.1 scores 60.9 on the same suite; Fable 5 scored 42.0, Opus 5 52.3, GPT-5.6 Sol 37.3.

Terminal-Bench-Science 0.1 (70 agentic science tasks), System Card Table 8.1.A — the single largest reported gain, more than double Fable 5's 24.7. Standard error +/-3.5-4.5 pts; Anthropic's setup reproduces the public leaderboard's Opus 5 30.0 / Fable 5 21.4 as 29.0 / 24.7, both within noise.
Humanity's Last Exam, NO-tools configuration, System Card Table 8.1.A (with-tools scores 65.0). Ahead of Fable 5 (57.8) and Opus 5 (56.6).

OSWorld 2.0, partial-credit metric per corpus convention (strict binary 41.7), System Card Table 8.1.A. NOTE: run on the benchmark authors' August 2026 task release, which Anthropic explicitly says is NOT comparable with previously published OSWorld 2.0 results — including the earlier rows in this file. Both Fable 5.1 and Fable 5 scored zero on tasks where production safeguards intervened.
GDPval-AA v2 Elo, System Card Table 8.1.A; +130 over Fable 5 (1723) and narrowly ahead of Opus 5 (1824).
AA-Briefcase Elo, System Card Table 8.1.A; vs Fable 5 1572, Opus 5 1685, GPT-5.6 Sol 1502.
AutomationBench, System Card Table 8.1.A — nearly double Fable 5's 17.1, ahead of Opus 5 (26.9). Fable 5's number is itself depressed by safeguard interventions scoring zero.
ARC-AGI-1, run by the ARC Prize team on their own semi-private test set — fully independent. Note Fable 5 scores HIGHER (98.5).
ARC-AGI-2 at max effort, ARC Prize semi-private test set. Behind GPT-5.6 Sol (92.5) and level with Opus 5 (90.4).

CursorBench 3.2.0 at max effort, run by Cursor rather than Anthropic and quoted in the launch post by Datadog/Cursor; state of the art at launch. At medium effort it scores 68.0 for $3.53/task, beating GPT-5.6 Sol's max-effort 67.2 at roughly two-thirds the cost.

DeepSWE v1.1, mean over five trials, System Card. Anthropic flags a scoring artefact: reviewing failing transcripts it found 'equally valid or more rigorous' implementations that still failed hidden tests written for a single reference solution.

FrontierCode v1.1 Main set; figure as tabulated in OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra launch comparison. Anthropic's own system card records Fable 5.1 marginally BELOW Fable 5 at the highest effort settings and attributes it to a scope-creep grading quirk rather than reduced capability.
FrontierCode v1.1 Extended set; figure as tabulated in OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra launch comparison (Anthropic reports 63.6 at medium effort).
GPQA Diamond; figure as tabulated in OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra launch comparison, level with Claude Opus 5 (93.7).
BenchCAD Vision2Code, geometric-overlap score as reported for Fable 5.1 in OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra launch comparison.
